title: The Flea and the Ox

full_text:
A flea bit a colossal ox upon the neck and asked: "How can you, who are so huge and strong, endure to be a slave to man, toiling under a heavy yoke every day, while I feast upon their blood whenever I please?"

The ox replied: "I serve man because he cherishes me: he pats my head, provides me with warm straw, and feeds me sweet grain. But as for you, whenever man feels your presence, he crushes you without mercy!"
moral: The drudge serves with patience, while the parasite complains of the smallest rebuff.
